# Laksa -- migration inventory and derivation

The AC-10.3 pattern from the reference migration: every entry in Laksa's `bin/.devbin/config.yaml` and every handler under `cmd/` is DERIVED from the launcher it replaces, via this document. Read the old side (`bin/laksa`, `bin/laksa_*`, 2026-08-09) before writing anything on the new side.

## The old surface

15 commands (`LAKSA_COMMANDS` in `bin/laksa_helpers`): `server iex repl cli test check fmt content products db build log docs version precommit`. Shared options parsed in every handler: `--env dev|test|prod` -> MIX_ENV, `--repl` -> REPL_MODE=true, `--iex` -> LAKSA_IEX=true. Project env: `laksa_config_env` (LAKSA_CONFIG_PATH=. LAKSA_CONFIG_FILE=config.json, set-if-unset) and `repl_mode_on` (REPL_MODE=true unless caller says false). Version: mix.exs is the ONE home, no VERSION file, no sidecars. Seals: `tmp/test/<stamp>.{mix,credo}.{out,errors}` + LATEST_{MIX,CREDO} pointers, lowercase suffix family.

## Command dispositions

| Old                            | New                                        | Kind                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `laksa server`                 | `cmd/server`                               | Thin handler: laksa env + the :4040/:4077 banner + D20's two command lines (`mix phx.server` / `iex -S mix phx.server`). Catalogue @builtin lacks the env + banner.               |
| `laksa iex`                    | `cmd/iex`                                  | Thin handler: laksa env + REPL_MODE default + `iex -S mix`. Catalogue row lacks the env.                                                                                          |
| `laksa repl`                   | `cmd/repl`                                 | Thin handler: laksa env + rlwrap_exec (devbin lib/helpers) with Laksa's real paths -- completions `bin/completions/completions.txt` (builtin assumes `repl.txt`), history via LAKSA_REPL_HISTORY. REPL_MODE deliberately not forced (the cli task owns it). |
| `laksa cli`                    | `cmd/cli`                                  | Thin handler: laksa env + REPL_MODE default + `exec mix laksa.cli "$@"`.                                                                                                          |
| `laksa test mix`               | `cmd/test.d/mix`                           | Full port of the glyph-feed sealed runner onto devbin's lib/runlog primitives (open_run_log, write_errors_file, note_promotion, purge machinery, mix grammar). Wrapper flags kept: --verbose/--with-errors --no-out --out-dir --purge --purge-only --no-trace --no-color --report/--no-report. Suffix moves to devbin's family (MIX). |
| `laksa test credo`             | `cmd/test.d/credo`                         | Same shape: seal + zero-checked promotion + --no-strict. Suffix CREDO.                                                                                                            |
| `laksa test all`               | `cmd/test` (all branch)                    | Both gates, continue past breach, summary; WIDENED to accept the gate wrapper flags (`test all --purge`, hv's fleet ruling 2026-08-09) and refuse everything else.                 |
| `laksa test integration`       | `cmd/test` (integration branch)            | Same runner, `--include integration` prepended (Highlander).                                                                                                                      |
| bare `laksa test`              | `cmd/test`                                 | Topic + warn + **exit 2** -- Laksa's authored ruling, preserved verbatim by the shadow.                                                                                            |
| `laksa check codegen`          | config row                                 | `run: mix ash.codegen --check`, grammar generic, log CODEGEN. No catalogue row exists.                                                                                            |
| `laksa check format`           | catalogue @builtin                         | Derives `mix format --check-formatted` for elixir -- exact old parity. The fmt md override does not trip the derivation guard (md is not a language arm).                          |
| `laksa check deps`             | catalogue row                              | `mix deps.unlock --check-unused` -- exact match, no entry.                                                                                                                        |
| `laksa check compile`          | config override                            | Old forces MIX_ENV=test (test/support is compiled in no other env -- authored ruling). Catalogue runs plain. `run: cmd/.lib/check-compile`, grammar mix + log COMPILE restated.    |
| `laksa check toolchain`        | config override                            | Old has THREE arms: pin vs active, plus pin vs Dockerfile ARGs. Catalogue @builtin lacks the Dockerfile arm -- the arm that is red today. `run: cmd/.lib/check-toolchain`, grammar generic + log TOOLCHAIN restated. Framework generalisation raised as a WP-11 delta candidate (Conflab restates the same ARGs; Baize/Lamplight will answer whether it generalises). |
| `laksa check critic`           | catalogue @builtin                         | Same shape (declared-langs x headless, --staged default). Parity probed at equivalence.                                                                                           |
| `laksa check all`              | synthesised                                | Old ran toolchain FIRST (deliberate: read the compiler line before the others). Devbin runs catalogue-then-declared order. Recorded as a deliberate difference; the sweep is complete either way. |
| `laksa fmt` / `fmt <paths>`    | catalogue fmt.elixir                       | `mix format` -- exact match.                                                                                                                                                      |
| `laksa fmt --check`            | (removed)                                  | D21: `check format` is the gate. Known rename, ruled pre-WP-10 (tasks.md).                                                                                                        |
| `laksa fmt --md`               | config override `fmt md`                   | Old: prettier over `**/*.md` honouring .prettierignore. Catalogue fmt.md is root-only. `run: cmd/.lib/fmt-md`, grammar generic + log FMTMD restated.                              |
| `laksa content ...`            | `cmd/content`                              | Straight port (link/sync/backsync); re-enters the dispatcher for cli. Opt-in: `enabled: true`.                                                                                    |
| `laksa products ...`           | `cmd/products`                             | Straight port; `money` calls `mix laksa.products.money` with laksa env directly (the old path went through the `bin/mix` shim); `validate` re-enters `devbin cli`. Tier-1 auto.   |
| `laksa db proxy`               | `cmd/db` (proxy)                           | Straight port (fly proxy via PGBouncer IPv6). Full shadow -- Laksa's db is mixed ash/ecto + fly, with per-sub prod guards.                                                        |
| `laksa db sql`                 | `cmd/db.d/sql`                             | Straight port (base64d Elixir over fly ssh; LAKSA_PROD_DB_PASS env seam kept as-is, rotation out of scope exactly as the old header says).                                        |
| `laksa db setup/reset/seed`    | `cmd/db`                                   | ecto.setup / ecto.reset / seeds.exs with the MIX_ENV=prod refusals, as old.                                                                                                       |
| `laksa db codegen <name>`      | `cmd/db`                                   | ash.codegen, name mandatory (the bare-hang guard, recorded in lib/cmd/db's absence note).                                                                                        |
| `laksa db migrate`             | `cmd/db`                                   | `mix ash.migrate` (catalogue row is ecto.migrate -- shadowed).                                                                                                                    |
| `laksa build ...`              | `cmd/build`                                | Straight port (release/assets/deploy/clean). deploy's internal gate calls route to `cmd/test.d/credo --no-out` and `cmd/test.d/mix --no-trace` and `devbin check codegen` -- one runner per gate (Highlander), as old. |
| `laksa log ...`                | `cmd/log`                                  | Straight port. Tier-1 auto.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `laksa docs agents/treeindex`  | catalogue @builtin + config                | `docs.treeindex_dirs: [bin, lib, test, config, credo_checks]`. `docs all` synthesised = old docs_all.                                                                             |
| `laksa version ...`            | catalogue @builtin + config                | `version_from: mix.exs` -- the exact case the reference config's comment names. read_version and the write recipes both know mix.exs. No handler.                                 |
| `laksa precommit`              | `cmd/precommit`                            | Straight port (staged md via prettier --write NO prose-wrap flag + staged elixir via mix format, re-stage). Opt-in: `enabled: true`. The .git/hooks line keeps working across the switch (`bin/laksa precommit` resolves through the symlink). |
| bare `laksa` / `-v`            | dispatcher                                 | Bare -> generated help (old: full help, exit 0 -- parity). `-v` -> `laksa <version>` via version_from ✓.                                                                          |
| unknown command                | dispatcher                                 | Both exit 2 -- probed at equivalence; the predicted 2->1 difference did not exist (devbin's rc-1 usage ruling covers BARE commands, not unknown ones).                             |

## Options

`env` and `repl` declared (`MIX_ENV`, `REPL_MODE`); `--iex` is D20 framework-owned. One recorded difference: devbin consumes declared options ANYWHERE in a command's argv (fleet-uniform, matches every old Laksa command except `cli`, which scoped them to pre-command after being bitten). Exposure probed: no laksa/arca task declares --env/--repl/--iex switches today. The `--repl` flag's one real use (`server --repl`) survives as `REPL_MODE=true bin/laksa server` -- same export, same effect.

## Shims and files that stay

`bin/{cli,dbproxy,flysql,iex,repl,server,taillog,test}` all exec `bin/laksa <cmd>` -- they ride through the switch. `bin/mix` and `bin/echo` are the project's own (bin/mix stops being load-bearing when cmd/products calls mix directly, but stays). `bin/completions/completions.txt` stays at its old path (cmd/repl names it).

## Toolchain sweep (hv's standing directive)

- Dockerfile ARGs: 1.20.1 / 28.1 / bookworm-20260610-slim -> 1.20.3 / 29.0.5 / registry-verified bookworm tag. This is the arm `check toolchain` is red on today -- the matching-red equivalence row.
- CI derives versions from .tool-versions (verified); its absent-file fallbacks (1.20.1 / 28.1) bumped to the pins for honesty.
- .tool-versions already uniform (erlang 29.0.5, elixir 1.20.3-otp-29, landed 2026-08-09).

## Help

15 authored topics migrate verbatim (help-migration.md rules 1, 4, 5), rulings extracted first. Prettier-stable from the first commit -- Laksa's pre-commit hook runs `prettier --write` with NO prose-wrap flag (preserve), so the proof is plain `prettier --check` over help/. The global heredoc dies (Rule 3); its fragments land in help.tagline, the group annotations ("bare `test` exits 2..."), and options.*.summary.

## Old-side gates, verbatim, for the equivalence pack

`test mix` (mix test --trace, glyph feed), `test credo` (mix credo --strict), `check {codegen,format,deps,compile,toolchain,critic}`, seals under tmp/test with lowercase suffixes. Old-side reds expected today: `check toolchain` (Dockerfile arm). Counts recorded from seals at equivalence time, not here.
